chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on buying an animal for milk, consuming it, and returning it?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi, transmitted via the reliable chain of Hammad ibn al-Halabi, confirms the applicability of the preceding ruling on purchasing livestock specifically for milk consumption. It highlights the scholarly emphasis on the intention (niyyah) behind the transaction, ensuring that the animal is acquired for a legitimate, temporary use rather than mere speculation, thereby validating the permissibility of the practice within Shia fiqh.
